notes: This record covers Digit 4, the generation Agility retrospectively identifies at GXO and other production-floor customers after roughly three years of use by September 2026. Ford’s CES 2020 first-customer announcement concerns an earlier Digit generation and is not evidence for Digit 4. GXO’s operational deployment supports shipped status for this exact generation.

No directly sourced height, weight, payload, or battery specifications for Digit 4 were located during this build, so specs remain empty rather than borrowing Digit 5 figures. See agility-digit for the distinct Digit 5 generation and its claimed specifications.
Digit is sold as Robots-as-a-Service, not a one-time purchase, so price_history is intentionally empty.

Shipped status rests on GXO’s named operational Digit deployment, with Agility’s 15 September 2026 account explicitly identifying the GXO robots as Digit 4. Amazon’s 2023 future-tense testing announcement remains insufficient for customer receipt in that report; Ford 2020 is excluded from this generation. Exact delivery dates, unit counts, and independent variant verification remain unknown.
